name: Modern Horrors
summary:
If you're easily scared, don't play this game, you'll literally die :)

Modern Horrors is a phycological horror game based around the famous analog horror videos across social media.  Play each terrifying level with friends, unlock many unique cosmetics, and uncover secrets that reveal the ball-shattering story that multiplayer games usually don't have.
